content.answer: Fix rule: when updating a single-select (or any id-referenced option list), always merge by stable id, never rebuild by name — for every existing option name, pass the original option object through with its existing id unchanged; only genuinely new names get fresh ids, starting from max(existing id)+1. Rebuilding the list from names alone forces the API to create brand-new ids and silently clears/breaks every existing row's reference to those options.
content.reuse_advice: For any id-referenced catalog update: first fetch the current catalog with its ids; match incoming entries to existing ones by stable id (or unique name); carry existing entries forward with their original ids untouched; assign new ids to new entries only, continuing the sequence from max(existing id)+1; then send the full merged list in one update. Never send a name-only list to an id-keyed catalog API — it rebuilds ids and silently severs all existing row references.
